Each result links back to the protocol it was run from, which was published first and is
unchanged. A result page reports what the analysis found and every defect found while running
it, including the ones that changed the answer.

## Defects are part of the result

Every study here reports the bugs found during its own run, what each one cost, and which
direction the correction moved the estimate. That is not modesty. Generated analysis code fails
silently: it produces a number rather than an error, and the number is plausible. The first
study found two such defects, one of which was inflating its own effect through an artifact and
one of which was suppressing it.

A result published without that section is a result whose checks either were not run or were
not reported, and neither is a reason to trust it more.

## Review

No result here has been reviewed. Review is by two models from different providers, each
instructed to refute the study, and no study is reviewed by one model alone. The second
reviewer's quota resets on 2026-09-20.

The protocols were published before the analyses ran, which is the property that matters most
and is preserved regardless of when review happens: the analysis could not redefine its own
question after seeing the answer.
